eurofintec-728-143.summary: Two brush machines for the work around a tube shop's saw and polisher. The 728 brushes round tube: a Ø11-13/16″ brush on a two-speed, self-braking motor works the tube while a grooved rubber contrast roller — tilted to feed it and pneumatically compensated — carries it past, cleaning, satin-finishing or polishing tube from Ø3/8″ to Ø5-7/8″, with handwheel adjustment as the brush wears. gecam-cws.name: CWS 200 · CWS 300 corner welding machines for bent boxes, parts to 59 × 59″
gecam-cws.summary: Welds the corners of bent boxes, cabinets, trays and enclosures in mild steel, stainless and aluminum with a TIG or plasma torch moved by the machine instead of by hand. The operator places the part with its corner against the external copper guide and presses the clamp button — a pneumatic cylinder anchors it from inside against copper blocks that hold the corner and draw the heat away — then presses start: the torch goes to the start point and welds the corner at the set speed. The parameters of each part are stored on the CNC touch screen. Corners 7-7/8″ high on the CWS 200 and 11-13/16″ on the CWS 300, parts from 3-15/16 × 3-15/16″ to 59 × 59″; two-axis torch movement is available.
